reference_sql:
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- one row per store open for the whole of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT store_code
  FROM stores
  WHERE opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01' AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= DATE '2025-12-31')
)
SELECT l.store_code,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025
FROM lfl_stores l
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_code = l.store_code
GROUP BY l.store_code

SELECT st.store_code,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'), 0) AS revenue_2024,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'), 0) AS revenue_2025
FROM stores st
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_code = st.store_code
WHERE st.opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01' AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY st.store_code

WITH yearly AS (
  -- one row per store and year with sales
  SELECT store_code, year(order_date) AS sales_year, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY store_code, year(order_date)
)
SELECT st.store_code, COALESCE(y24.revenue, 0) AS revenue_2024, COALESCE(y25.revenue, 0) AS revenue_2025
FROM stores st
LEFT JOIN yearly y24 ON y24.store_code = st.store_code AND y24.sales_year = 2024
LEFT JOIN yearly y25 ON y25.store_code = st.store_code AND y25.sales_year = 2025
WHERE st.opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01' AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= DATE '2025-12-31')
